name: Parity arguments
definition: Some things are impossible because an odd or even count can never change into the other. If every move flips two lights at once, the number switched on always changes by an even amount, so an odd target is unreachable. Parity proves impossibility, which counting never can.
recognizeWhen: each move changes two of them at once
can the counters ever all be face up
the pieces must be covered in pairs
misconceptions: I tried more and more examples instead of asking what never changes.
I found that parity was preserved but did not check the starting and target parities differ.
I claimed something was impossible when my move actually could change the parity.
